title: Cappuccino Assassino
blurb: The killer coffee, and the other half of the brainrot universe's most committed romantic subplot. Italian brainrot produced an entire espresso-based faction — assassins, ballerinas, an alarming number of anthropomorphic beverages. Read it as sharp commentary on Italian national identity, or read it as what an image generator produces when asked to invent characters at three in the morning. Both hold up equally well. The name scans like a spell, and that is the reason it spread. The lore was assembled retrospectively by twelve-year-olds and is now, apparently, canon.
origin: An Italian brainrot AI character: the assassin cappuccino.
